- **Where I looked:** the channels Ilse is in (#north-team, #north-random, #inc-qfl-sev1 and #general), our direct message, and the public North team digests, including Moss's North cheat sheet.
- **What turned up:** the digests mention Tamsin Cold Chain problems (a timeout on the reefer temp-check form at the Tacoma yard, and a stuck report export). None of them names a person at the customer. The shared drive has no Tamsin Cold Chain account files (CRM, profile or tickets).
- **What I told Ilse:** Dana Okafor runs the account on our side. The digests call it "the Northwest one Dana inherited." So I pointed Ilse to Dana for the right contact rather than guessing a name.

I didn't use `search_messages` or read any channel Ilse isn't in, and I didn't share anything else.
